name: bcpsai
description: browardschools.ai (Broward Powered by AI). Static site served from the repo root. This package.json exists so Vercel can install the dependencies used by middleware.ts, the login-required gate on the site root and the BCPS AI Progress Tracker, and so /auth-client.js can be rebuilt. Note there is deliberately no script named "build": Vercel auto-runs that one, and this site is plain HTML served straight from the repo root with no build step. Rebuild the auth bundle by hand with: npm install && npm run build:auth-client (commit the result).
